$schema-note: The motif layer of the design brief (2026-08-27) §3.8. A fourth, optional layer beside the three token tiers. A motif set is a named group of small SVG drawings.
$asset-note: Each set stores its drawings under apps/web/public/motifs/<set>/. SVG only, never a raster. Every path uses currentColor or a theme custom property, so a motif inherits ink from --color-ink-motif-rgb and carries no color of its own. A reviewer checks that by hand: the hex sweep does not lint SVG.
$render-note: Render a motif one of two ways only (brief §3.8). Either apply the slot token as a CSS mask-image and paint it with background-color: var(--color-ink-motif-rgb), or inline the file as an SVG symbol that reads currentColor. Never an , never a CSS url() fill: neither form can inherit theme ink. Every motif is aria-hidden="true" and pointer-events: none, and a page carries at most three.
$switch-note: A custom property cannot rewrite the asset a second custom property points at, so --motif-set alone can never remap the slot URLs. The root element carries data-motif-set instead, and the generator emits one [data-motif-set] block per set, each resolving every slot token to that set's asset. Same mechanism as data-theme and data-mode.
$icon-note: The line between a motif and an icon is meaning, not shape. A mark that names a specific line, venue, or room carries meaning: that mark is a labelled icon, it lives under apps/web/public/icons/wayfinding/, and it never renders through this layer.

fauna.label: Fauna
fauna.style: Engraving and plate linework (brief §2.3). The supported alternate for Field Guide, and the second engraved set a Broadsheet client may enable.

cartographic.label: Cartographic
cartographic.style: Precise survey linework (brief §2.3). The set carries the transit register too: the divider is a Beck-style schematic line diagram of straight segments and 45 degree turns, and the section mark is a contour and benchmark mark.
cartographic.$transit-note: Route marks and station symbols name a specific line, venue, or room, so they are labelled icons under apps/web/public/icons/wayfinding/, never motifs (brief §3.8).
